200.description:
Player box score (player stats, props auditing) for one game from ESPN's `site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/{sport}/{league}/summary?event=`: the event card (status, final score), per-team per-period linescores, and every player's stat line grouped by ESPN's categories with ESPN's stat keys, labels and descriptions preserved: NFL passing/rushing/receiving/defensive/kicking/punting/returns, NHL forwards/defense and goalies (shots on goal = key `shotsTotal`, time on ice, saves, save percentage), NBA points/rebounds/assists/minutes, MLB batting and pitching, soccer match rosters including goalkeepers (saves, goals conceded). Categories are read generically, so any league ESPN gives a box score for works. Also the per-team game leaders (e.g. passing/rushing/receiving yards, goals/assists/points). A scheduled game has no player lines (`teams: []` with a `note`); when ESPN reports every player stat as 0 for a match with a non-zero score (some women's soccer competitions) the lines are null with a `note` rather than zeros. An unknown event, or an event of another league, is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `teams` as the primary payload key.

200.description:
One event's summary from `site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/{sport}/{league}/summary?event=`: header (status, start time, competitors, scores, records), venue, attendance, officials, team box-score statistics as ESPN labels them, scoring/key plays (NFL `scoringPlays`; soccer match details flagged scoringPlay) and the recap headline. Per-player box scores and per-period linescores are the `boxscore` function. When ESPN publishes a final score but all-zero team statistics and no match details (some women's competitions, e.g. Liga MX Femenil), `team_statistics[].statistics` is null and `team_statistics_note`/`key_plays_note` say the data is unavailable rather than zero. ESPN does not validate the league path, so an event that belongs to another league is `not_found` rather than mislabeled. An unknown event_id is `not_found`.

post.description: Check NHL, NFL, NBA, MLB or WNBA injuries (Out, IR, day-to-day, questionable) before a game, for tonight's clubs, fantasy lineups or betting/props research; feed athlete_id to `player`.

league.description: ESPN league slug within the sport: nba, wnba, nfl, mlb, nhl, college-football (from `leagues`). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$.

sport.description: ESPN sport slug, e.g. football, soccer, basketball, baseball, hockey (from `leagues` without `sport`). Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.

status.description: Only players with this status, matched case- and punctuation-insensitively against the status, its abbreviation and its code: e.g. Out, day-to-day, DD, Questionable, IR.

team.description: Only these teams: one or more ESPN team ids (e.g. 29) or abbreviations (e.g. CBJ, LAL), comma-separated, from `teams`. Every named team is returned, with an empty list when ESPN lists no injuries for it. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}(\s*,\s*[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}){0,39}$.

200.description:
NFL, NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL and college football injury report (who is out, injured reserve, day-to-day, questionable) from `site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/{sport}/{league}/injuries` (one keyless request): every team ESPN lists with its injured players, each with athlete_id, name, position, status (Out, Day-To-Day, Questionable, Injured Reserve, IL...), note date, short and long comment, injury type and details when ESPN gives them, and the ESPN player URL, plus the feed timestamp. ESPN omits teams with no injuries from the report (e.g. NHL: 31 of 32 clubs listed), so pass `team` (one or more ESPN team ids or abbreviations, comma-separated, e.g. `MIN,CAR,CBJ` for tonight's clubs): each named team is always returned, a healthy one with an empty list, `count: 0` and a note (one extra request resolves the names against the league's team list; an unknown team is `not_found`). `status` filters players. Verified for basketball/nba, basketball/wnba, football/nfl, baseball/mlb, hockey/nhl and football/college-football; a league with no listed injuries (offseason, or one ESPN does not report, e.g. soccer) is an empty `teams` list with a `note`. An unknown sport/league, or a league ESPN keeps no injury report for (racing, golf, MMA), is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `teams` as the primary payload key.

injuries.long_comment: Gilbert continues to deal with patella tendinitis. His last chance to appear this preseason is Friday against the Mavericks.
injuries.short_comment: Gilbert (knee) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.long_comment: Wiggins and most of Atlanta's regulars won't play in the penultimate preseason game. He finished with 13 points (4-9 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), two rebounds, an assist and two steals across 20 minutes off the bench in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
injuries.short_comment: Wiggins (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Okongwu is getting the night off Monday with Atlanta resting a number of starters. His next chance to play arrives Friday against Dallas.
injuries.short_comment: Okongwu (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.long_comment: McCollum and most of Atlanta's regulars won't play in the penultimate preseason game. He recorded 12 points (2-4 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 7-7 FT) and five rebounds across 19 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
injuries.short_comment: McCollum (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Dort is sitting out Monday for maintenance purposes. The veteran swingman's next chance to play is Friday against Dallas.
injuries.short_comment: Dort (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.long_comment: Johnson and most of Atlanta's regulars won't suit up for the penultimate preseason contest. He tallied 20 points (8-12 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and three assists over 25 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
injuries.short_comment: Johnson (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Daniels and most of Atlanta's regulars will rest during the Hawks' penultimate preseason contest. He tallied 13 points (6-16 FG, 1-3 3Pt), 11 rebounds, an assist and a steal across 21 minutes in Thursday's 123-116 preseason win over the Spurs but struggled with his shot against the Pacers on Saturday.
injuries.short_comment: Daniels (rest) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.
injuries.short_comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.long_comment: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).
injuries.short_comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Garza took an inadvertent elbow to the nose from teammate Chris Cenac, and the former was taken to the locker room shortly thereafter. Assuming Garza doesn't return, he'll end his night with eight points (4-9 FG), seven rebounds and one assist over 11 minutes.
injuries.short_comment: Garza (nose) went to the locker room late in the fourth quarter of Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Bobby Manning of CLNS Media Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Carter played 25 minutes during Boston's preseason opener against Cleveland on Thursday, but the third-year pro is under the weather and not be available for Saturday's contest. His next chance to play is Wednesday against Charlotte.
injuries.short_comment: Carter (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's exhibition game against the 76ers, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

injuries.long_comment: Harper is working through right shoulder illness, which has prevented him from playing in each of the Celtics' first two preseason games. His next opportunity to play is Wednesday against the Hornets.
injuries.short_comment: Harper (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

injuries.long_comment: Jefferson will be sidelined for his third straight exhibition. The rookie forward will have one more chance to return in the preseason Oct. 14 against the Heat.
injuries.short_comment: Jefferson (back) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

injuries.long_comment: Brown has yet to suit up during the preseason as he continues to work his way back from a left ankle issue. His final chance to get in an exhibition is Wednesday against the Heat.
injuries.short_comment: Brown (ankle) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

injuries.long_comment: Anderson will miss a second straight game due to a left ankle sprain. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's exhibition against the Celtics.
injuries.short_comment: Anderson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against Milwaukee.

injuries.long_comment: Allen performed well in the Hornets' opening preseason game, posting 13 points in 14 minutes, but he will miss Sunday's contest with a knee injury. Sion James and Royce O'Neale could see extra action with Allen out of the lineup.
injuries.short_comment: Allen will not play in Sunday's preseason game against the Bucks due to right knee soreness.

injuries.long_comment: It doesn't sound like the two-way guard will be available for the preseason, but he's hopeful to not miss any time during the G League season. Boswell is not expected to be a significant part of the Hornets' rotation this season.
injuries.short_comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.

injuries.long_comment: White missed time with a left calf strain last season and is now in jeopardy of starting the regular season on the inactive list. If the 26-year-old guard is forced to miss time beyond the preseason, Christian Anderson and Dennis Schroder would likely see increased playing time.
injuries.short_comment: The Hornets announced Monday that White suffered a left calf strain during training camp and will not play during the preseason.

injuries.long_comment: Knueppel's status for Opening Night remains uncertain as he continues to work his way back from his left hamstring injury. Peterson's comments suggest the Hornets aren't ready to rule out the second-year wing, though his availability will likely become clearer as training camp progresses. He has already been ruled out for the entire preseason, to be clear.
injuries.short_comment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

injuries.long_comment: Williams will be re-evaluated the first week of the regular season, putting his status for Opening Night in the air. Williams will have a difficult path to minutes this season as he competes with the likes of Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun.
injuries.short_comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

injuries.long_comment: Collins has yet to suit up in the preseason due to a toe injury but is making progress ahead of the regular season. The big man's final chance to suit up in the preseason will come Friday against Minnesota.
injuries.short_comment: Collins (toe) is progressing in his recovery but has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason meeting with the Bucks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Awaka banged his knee in Friday's preseason game against Memphis. The undrafted rookie can be deemed questionable for Wednesday's exhibition versus the Bucks.
injuries.short_comment: Awaka (knee) didn't practice Tuesday, per K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network.

injuries.long_comment: It's unclear why Okoro didn't practice, though he can be considered questionable for Wednesday's exhibition against Milwaukee. If the 25-year-old wing is unable to suit up, Leonard Miller, Jordan Hawkins and Buddy Hield could see a bump in playing time.
injuries.short_comment: Okoro (undisclosed) didn't participate in Tuesday's practice, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Sellers continues to deal with lower-back soreness that has limited his preseason availability. The two-way guard will look to return to action as Chicago completes its exhibition schedule, though his immediate fantasy outlook remains limited.
injuries.short_comment: Sellers (back) did not play in Sunday's 133-128 preseason loss to Denver.

injuries.long_comment: This is a huge blow for Claxton and it rules him out for the entire preseason. For now, fantasy managers can consider him questionable for Opening Night on Oct. 21 against the Raptors. Jalen Smith is the next man up on the depth chart for Chicago, followed by Zach Collins (toe).
injuries.short_comment: Claxton tweaked his hamstring and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network of the Bulls Radio Network reports.
